name: Slime Trials
author: Canight (Canite); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Slime Trials by Canight, a Game Boy Competition 2023 entry: a precision platformer where a little slime makes its way through tricky rooms against the clock. MIT license (github.com/Canite/SlimeTrials).

descriptions.en: Slime Trials by Canight, a Game Boy Competition 2023 entry: a precision platformer where a little slime makes its way through tricky rooms against the clock. MIT license (github.com/Canite/SlimeTrials).
descriptions.it: Slime Trials di Canight, in gara alla Game Boy Competition 2023: un platform di precisione in cui una piccola melma si fa strada attraverso stanze insidiose, contro il cronometro. Licenza MIT (github.com/Canite/SlimeTrials).
